literature_notes: Both ledger lines (L1, L2) describe the identical construct: hRobo4-HA-FLAG, generated by cloning ROBO4 cDNA (NM_019055.5) into the NheI/NotI sites of pCDH-EF1-FHC (Addgene #64874). That vector appends FLAG and HA epitope tags to the C-terminus of the cloned insert. ROBO4 is a type-I single-pass transmembrane protein (extracellular 28–468, TM 469–489, intracellular 490–1007); its C-terminus (residue 1007, S) is intracellular. The HA-FLAG tags therefore reside on the cytoplasmic face and do not constitute an extracellular surface tag. No ledger line reports a tag insertion at the extracellular N-terminus (after residue 27), within the large ectodomain (28–468), or anywhere else on the extracellular face. Zero extracellular surface sites qualify.

literature_other_positions.note: HA-FLAG tags appended to the ROBO4 C-terminus via pCDH-EF1-FHC (Addgene #64874); residue 1007 (S) is in the intracellular domain (490–1007), so the tags face the cytoplasm, not the extracellular surface.
